_comment: Live camera configuration. Copy to config.json on the host, at the path
the deployer bind-mounts (paths.config/home-cameras), never inside the
deploy directory: a re-deploy replaces that tree and every camera would
Keyed by device IP. The username and password are the camera's own RTSP
credentials and are stored in the clear, because that is what the stream
URL needs -- keep this file 600 and off the share.
